# A17-S07: Use rights

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

Ok, but I just need to understand if this is different from what we've agreed so far? Because we agreed on the division of copyright/usage rights and that I don't make the same project elsewhere.

[…]
The most important thing for me is just that usage rights work like for an artwork and not a tech product. Just like if you bought a painting, for example, which you can then exhibit as you want, resell, etc. without asking me. That's totally fine, but I wouldn't endorse that you can further develop the painting after sale, e.g., insert a new picture or erase something.

Therefore, I don't want anyone other than me to modify, edit, or change texts or programs. I must be able to stand behind what is there, and I see that as an extension of my copyright. For example, I don't want data lying open source due to the risk of misuse.

But of course, according to usage rights, you can put the chatbot on all the websites you want, also without asking me. And circulate the texts. Although I would prefer a notification :-)

I also continue to own the characters I use in the fiction. That is, for example, Computer Lars or Carol Stumper I will use again in the future. I will let Julina stay in this project, respecting not to do the same again.

And it then concerns the last part: I can refrain from making new art projects about political parties led by an AI. That's presumably the idea you have bought. But I can freely fine-tune more GPT-3 models for whatever I come up with, because that's just a method. And form political parties otherwise, if I should feel like it as a citizen.
